## v0.20

- Stick overshoot, properly fixed: the stick now reports exactly what you do, with no extra hold after release.
- The hold I added in v0.14 to help quick stick taps register in menus is now a setting, "Stick tap assist", off by default. Menus still react promptly to a held stick (the quick-wake from v0.14 stays); a very short tap (under about a quarter of a second) may be missed in some menus unless you turn the assist on, which brings back the overshoot in games.
